name: Curaçao Gaming Authority
role: Licenses and supervises online gaming in Curaçao.
coverage: All 669 numbered online gaming licence entries in the 2026-11-20 register (668 distinct licence numbers), including B2C operators, B2B suppliers and historical statuses. The CGA cautions that a listing does not establish present validity. All 30 entries in the 2026-11-12 enforcement register are included. It records selected decisions affecting licence status and excludes other measures. Operator-requested withdrawals in the licence register do not create enforcement cases here. Individual CGA certificates are checked for the configured B2C licences. The certificate observation date is shown separately from the original licensing and roster issue dates. Land-based casinos, lottery permits, and certificates are outside this edition.
